situation: During a vendor outage a colleague wanted to pass the vendor's fix estimate to customers as a resolution time.
decision: Give customers a next-update time and the honest vendor estimate, not a promised resolution time.

moves.name: promise next update time, not an ETA
moves.step: Commit to when customers will next hear from you rather than when it will be fixed.
moves.cue: pressure to give customers an ETA
moves.evidence: we will update them by 12:00 whether or not it is fixed

moves.name: never relay another party's ETA as ours
moves.step: Do not adopt an estimate you do not control as your own commitment.
moves.evidence: if we pass it on as ours and they miss it, we're the ones who missed it

moves.name: protect credibility of future updates
moves.step: Prefer commitments you can keep, because a missed one discounts every later update.
moves.cue: an update that might be broken
moves.evidence: every update after that is discounted

considerations.evidence: every update after that is discounted
